digest.component_or_area: CLI help system and generation pipeline
propositions: Generated CLI help artifacts must be deterministic, parser-derived, and free of hand-authored drift, with --check mode detecting missing/stale/stray resources and blank summaries as hard failures.
Top-level help pre-scan routing must complete before operation composition, config parsing, store mount, parser/handler resolution, and optional imports.

Every visible canonical command appears once in grouped overview; exact aliases reuse bytes; compatibility/hidden/retired spellings follow approved formatting rules with capitalized 'Usage:' prefix preserved byte-for-byte.
Factory enrichment with per-argument help text, descriptions, and SUPPRESS markers moves curated prose from hand-maintained artifacts into parser sources, enabling reliable generation.
Help artifact bodies are regenerated from true post-S2b/S2c factory grammar, correcting hand-captured drift and eliminating hand-maintained usage/option tables.
